served.pdasBasis: Ni-Nb model alloy band, Ghosh et al. 2017 (Modelling Simul. Mater. Sci. Eng. 25, 065002, doi 10.1088/1361-651X/aa7369) Fig. 6 caption: Eq. 7 Hunt A = 9.56e-4 and Eq. 8 Kurz-Fisher A = 2.6e-3 (m^0.75 s^-0.25 K^0.5), λ1 = A G^-0.5 R^-0.25. The phase-field PDAS values lie near Hunt (p.11); the line of best fit has a slope close to Kurz-Fisher with a constant offset (p.12), so the slope-only member is not served. The system is a dilute binary Ni-Nb model alloy (Table 2), applied to IN625 and IN718 as the closest sourced Ni-Nb system and not a measurement of those alloys; the coefficients are alloy specific. Validity: x = G^-0.5 R^-0.25 in [4e-4, 1.2e-3] and cooling rate 5e4 to 3e6 K/s (Fig. 6 abscissa and operating range, p.11); outside it the band is null (pdasOutOfRange)
